summary: Capital One Funding, LLC, as depositor for the Capital One Multi-Asset Execution Trust, filed a routine 8-K reporting the October 8, 2026 closing of its Class A(2026-3) and Class A(2026-4) notes, an ordinary credit-card ABS takedown under an existing shelf. No special-situation transaction is present. The filing states the Master Trust Transferor Interest was $9,621,358,708, or roughly 74.07% of aggregate adjusted outstanding investor ABS interests, satisfying U.S. credit risk-retention rules. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation appears. Watch only for ongoing issuance pace and retained-interest compliance; no risk-arb angle.
